name: comp-26
title: Search With Submit Button
blurb: Search input with search icon and submit arrow button.
description: A search field with a magnifying glass icon on the left and an arrow button on the right. Button is type='submit' to work in forms.
use_when: A search form where the visual icon and button guide the user through the interaction.
avoid_when: You need the search to work on every keystroke (this expects a form submission).
a11y: Label linked to input. Button has aria-label. Icons marked aria-hidden. Uses peer selector for coupled styling with input disabled state.
